reason: A DSH plugin that exposes the local Web UI through a LAN gateway with device approval, token and cookie binding, rate limiting, reverse proxying, and mobile layout adaptation.

summaries.zh: 通过局域网网关让手机和平板访问本机 DSH Web UI，并提供设备审批、令牌管理、限流和移动端布局适配。
summaries.en: Provides LAN access to the local DSH Web UI for phones and tablets with device approval, token management, rate limiting, and mobile layout adaptation.

capabilities: Runs an independent local gateway subprocess
Listens on a configurable network address and port
Reverse-proxies approved browser requests to the local DSH Web UI
Provides local device approval, denial, revocation, and access-mode management
Issues device tokens bound to browser cookies
Injects mobile-oriented HTML markers, CSS, and a browser API polyfill
